_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::particle_dem#3. 4C DOES compute a DEM critical time step and DOES check it -- and only warns. At 20x the deck's own step the warning is printed once per step (WARN_LINES counted against the 50 configured steps, WARN_IS_ONE_PER_STEP=yes), the time loop still reaches the end, the run still reaches the result-test manager (REACHED_RESULT_TESTS=yes), nothing in the time loop aborts (ABORTED_IN_THE_TIME_LOOP=no) and the only real symptom is VERDICTS_WRONG. SOURCE_FILE_MENTIONED=no records that the warning is a bare stream write with no file reference, unlike every FOUR_C_THROW in the module -- so a log filter keyed on 'PROC 0 ERROR' misses it entirely.
